$comment: Validated artifact. Typed source of truth: policy/dhall/redaction.dhall. Regenerate with: dhall-to-json --pretty --file policy/dhall/redaction.dhall. Drift and portability are enforced by tests/test_redaction_policy.py.

dialect.name: portable-re-v1
dialect.rule: Python re is the reference engine. Its \b, \w, \d and \s are Unicode-aware. RE2 reads all four as ASCII. An engine with ASCII-only \b must treat each match as a candidate and reject it when a real edge is not a Unicode word boundary, as src/ptoon/Redact.chpl does. An engine with ASCII-only \d or \s matches fewer digits and spaces than the reference. Text is NFKC-normalized first. That folds fullwidth digits and many space characters, but not other scripts' digits. A parity check must report any residual gap, never hide it.

replacement.rule: Each match becomes the token followed by the line-break characters the match contained, in order. Line numbering of the redacted text stays stable.
